FanzPro Partnership Research

Designation: Research and Inspiration This document does not establish a partnership, integration, rights grant, endorsement, or any formal relationship between 50 Ways to Leave Another / Loptr Lab and FanzPro LLC or Bryan Ogden.

Research date: 2026-09-21 Researcher: Dominique Devereaux / Loptr Lab Source session: Loptr Lab / SuperMe.ai conversation thread

What FanzPro does

FanzPro (fanzpro.com) is a dual-sided web platform connecting independent music artists with fans, bloggers, and affiliates who act as a decentralized sales team. Artists set up offers (merch, tickets, music releases, fan club memberships), define commission rates (8% to 20%), and supporters receive trackable referral links. Payouts trigger only on verified, completed sales. Infrastructure: Stripe Connect for disbursements, W-9 onboarding for tax compliance, local storage attribution codes for link tracking.

The platform is registered as FanzPro LLC, Nashville, TN. As of research date, status is Live Beta v1.01.

CEO: Bryan Ogden. Source: linkedin.com/in/bryanogden1 and bryanogden.com. Ogden describes his thesis as building technology that helps real people be heard, verified, and connected. He has 30+ years building systems and describes his AI consulting practice around trustworthy, privacy-first, human-in-the-loop deployment.

What FanzPro does not address

FanzPro has no mechanism for: - Documenting creator ownership of content before a sale occurs - Recording rights validity at the point of a revenue event - Generating structured dispute records for Content ID or platform monetization challenges - Supporting a creator in a licensing negotiation with a major label

These gaps are the basis for the Creator Rights Layer module stub (see docs/architecture/creator-rights-layer.md).

Potential complementarity with 50 Ways

FanzPro generates verified sales and performance data. The 50 Ways architecture generates provenance and rights documentation. A creator who uses both would have: a documented ownership record, a trackable performance record, and a paper trail that supports both a licensing conversation and a Content ID dispute response.

This complementarity is architectural, not contractual. No integration exists. No partnership has been proposed or agreed.

Connection context

Bryan Ogden initiated a LinkedIn connection with Dominique Devereaux on or around 2026-09-21, based on profile content. A direct message was sent following the connection. No response has been received as of the research date. This document predates any partnership conversation and is filed as independent research.
